_comment: Roster + overrides for the contractor update agent.
This file is NOT the source of truth for which contractors exist -- Trello is.
Each weekly run discovers every label on the Insured Appraisals board that has at
least one open card, and treats it as a client unless it appears in 'nonClientLabels'.
This file supplies the things Trello cannot know: display names, email domains,
per-rep splits, and the Send shareId once a page has been published.
_repLabelComment: Rep attribution reads a Trello LABEL on the card first -- authoritative, see runbook Pass 0.
'labelName' overrides the display 'name' when the Trello label is spelled differently.
The connector can attach an existing label but CANNOT create one: new rep labels must be
made in the Trello UI before a run can attach or read them.
_stageMapComment: The board has ~84 lists whose names carry operator instructions. Contractors see the
client-facing stage, never the raw list name.
TWO different orderings live here, do not conflate them:
* ARRAY ORDER = matching precedence. Lowercase the list name, walk this array in
order, first stage with a matching substring wins. Most specific stages come first,
which is why 'In umpire' precedes 'Settled' ('Umpire invoice paid' contains 'paid')
and why the payment-outstanding stage precedes 'Settled - paid' ('closed but not
* 'order' FIELD = display order on the page, sorted descending, so the files closest
If a list matches nothing it falls to 'New / intake' -- which is usually wrong, so the
run must report any list that fell through and the matcher gets added here.

stageMap.blurb: The two appraisers did not agree, so an umpire is deciding the file.
The claim is resolved. Our appraisal invoice is still open.
matchers: waiting on payment to sign award

stageMap.blurb: Closed out and paid. Nothing outstanding.
Appraisal was not the right route. The file has moved to an attorney or a public adjuster.
Positions exchanged. We are working the gap.
Property inspected. Our estimate and position are being prepared.
The carrier's appraiser is named. Locking in the inspection date.
The demand is with the carrier. Waiting for them to name their appraiser.
The estimate is with you and/or the homeowner. We need approval to move.
File received. Confirming details before we demand appraisal.

_debtCollectionNote: JUDGEMENT CALL, easy to change: files sitting in 'Need to send to debt collections',
'Sent to Debt Collections' and 'PAST DUES' are shown to the client as
'Settled - payment outstanding'. That is accurate -- the invoice IS open -- and it stops
an automated page from picking a fight with a client on Joseph's behalf. If Joseph wants
collections stated plainly, give those three lists their own stage here.
_excludeListsComment: Lists that do NOT hold client files. A card sitting in one of these is a contact record,
an agent rule, a divider or a staff task -- never a file, so it must never reach a status
page. Applied BEFORE stage mapping. Matched as lowercased substrings of the list name.
excludeLists: appraisers info that works for us
_excludeCardMarkersComment: Markers Joseph writes into a card's name or description to say it is not a live appraisal
file. A card carrying one never reaches a status page, whatever list it sits in.
Matched case-insensitively against card name + description.
_nonClientComment: Labels that are markets, difficulty tags, staff assignments or workflow flags -- never a client. Matched case-insensitively.
nonClientLabels: Lacking Info - need to follow up
_contractorComment: pageMode 'per-rep'  -> one Send page per named rep, plus one catch-all page for that
company's files with no rep resolved yet.
pageMode 'company'  -> one Send page for the whole company (the default).
shareId is written back by the weekly run the first time it publishes a page.
aliasLabels folds duplicate/typo labels into one client.
